title: Make first source-observation fixture independent of its two-second physical completion window
outcome: The first-observation source-owner test verifies one producer response supplies both pin and identity without failing solely because filesystem work or scheduling outlasts two seconds.
acceptance: source_owner_first_observation_supplies_pin_and_identity_without_a_second_source_read retains its exact two-call (--version, source), same-response identity and later independent-capture assertions while measuring completion/deadline semantics with controlled time or an appropriate non-racing boundary.
No production timeout is increased, retry or ignore added, or source-owner validation weakened; relevant focused checks and independent review cover the fixture change.
